item.title: Van Leeuwen Ice Cream
item.description: Satisfy your sweet tooth with scoops of Van Leeuwen Ice Cream. Purists will appreciate the not-so-simple perfection of Vanilla Bean. Created with high-quality ingredients, like cold-ground, whole Tahitian vanilla beans, milk, cream, cane sugar, egg yolks and vanilla extract, this anything-but-boring flavor has been named the best by The New York Times. item.title: Sweet Auburn Barbecue
item.description: Football season may be over, but luckily, it’s easy to find delicious wings in Atlanta all year round. Head to the Poncey-Highland mainstay Sweet Auburn Barbecue for Smoked Wings tossed in your choice of sauce, whether the local favorite—lemon pepper wet—or a spicy Szechuan influenced by sibling owners Howard and Anita Hsu’s Asian roots. item.title: LaRayia’s Bodega
item.description: For a healthful start to the new year, the stylish LaRayia’s Bodega is a must-stop at Ponce City Market. Try the bright and fresh Citrus Anti-Salad—a colorful mix of greens, juicy supremed grapefruit, crispy fried capers, shaved red onion and toasted seeds, all tossed together in a sweet-tangy burnt honey vinaigrette. item.title: Sézane
item.description: Sézane has finally opened its Parisian doors in Ponce City Market! Featuring their French Essentials Collection, Sézane mixes its chic French design with our city’s laid-back style—think soft knits, breezy blouses, gorgeously tailored denim and handcrafted bags. item.title: Mercato di Bellina
item.description: Give the gift of culture and flavor with curated gift baskets from Mercato di Bellina. Sourced directly from small Italian producers, each basket prioritizes high-quality, authentic ingredients celebrating all things Italy. item.title: Tiny Doors ATL
item.description: Tiny Doors ATL has you covered for an off-beat date night! Grab your honey and explore the Eastside Beltline Trail full of whimsical, mini door art pieces scattered along the way. Each intricate design is handcrafted by Karen Anderson Singer and reflects the atmosphere of its location. Ready, set, scavenger hunt! Details: tinydoorsatl.com The post Tiny Doors ATL first appeared on Atlanta Best Media.

item.title: Little Tart After Dark
item.description: Little Tart After Dark is Little Tart Bakeshop’s late-night cafe. Grab your date and stop in on Saturdays and Sundays from 5-9pm to enjoy a curated selection of wine, cocktails and elevated small bites like olives, pickled eggs, sandwiches and pastries. Details: 437 Memorial Dr. SE, littletartatl.com The post Little Tart After Dark first appeared on Atlanta Best Media.

item.description: The Splatter Studio is a total blast, where you can create a joint masterpiece with your special someone. item.title: The Supermarket
item.description: Don’t be fooled by the name…The Supermarket is a multi-use, creative space that holds a variety of community events featuring art galleries, live music, stand-up comedy, workshops and so much more.
